nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Respond immediately so Aakashvani is not blocked. WhatsApp/email send in the background.

nodes.name: Lead Context
nodes.notes: Unwrap webhook body in code so lead/phone/email always populate.

nodes.name: Store Lead
nodes.notes: Remember this lead by phone so WhatsApp replies can find it.

nodes.name: If Interested
nodes.notes: Exact interested/hot/warm only. "not interested" does not match.

nodes.name: Build Email
nodes.notes: Always builds subject/body from lead fields. No Gemini.

nodes.name: Lead Payload
nodes.notes: Pass-through contract for outbound and inbound.

nodes.name: Ensure WhatsApp Text
nodes.notes: Instant first message from backend fallback. No Gemini wait.

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp
nodes.notes: Sends via BhuvisX WhatsApp credential. Recipient is dynamic.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ client_id: $('Prepare Send').first().json.client_id, to_phone: $('Prepare Send').first().json.phone_e164, text: $('Prepare Send').first().json.message, lead_id: $('Prepare Send').first().json.lead_id || null, campaign_id: $('Prepare Send').first().json.campaign_id, customer_name: $('Prepare Send').first().json.customer_name, idempotency_key: $('Prepare Send').first().json.idempotency_key, direction: 'outgoing', status: 'sent' }) }}

nodes.name: Record in Aakashvani
nodes.notes: Writes the follow-up into Aakashvani Messages for that campaign/client.

nodes.name: If Customer Message
nodes.notes: Drop delivery receipts, empty messages, and our own echoes.

nodes.name: Lookup Lead
nodes.notes: Fetch full lead context from AakashVani GET /internal/leads/context (requires AAKASHVANI_PUBLIC_URL + AAKASHVANI_ADMIN_KEY in n8n env).

nodes.name: Generate Follow-up Email
nodes.notes: AI email. If it fails, Build Email still sends.

nodes.name: Generate WhatsApp Message
nodes.notes: AI WhatsApp. If it fails, Ensure WhatsApp Text still sends.
